statuses.pending: Required completed-game data is missing or processing has not finished.
statuses.partial: One team's update is available, but the next opponent has an intervening game that is not yet processed.
statuses.complete: All applicable team updates are current. An idle or bye opponent uses its unchanged current rating.

notes: Spread and total statuses are evaluated separately.
A bye does not prevent completion.
Use each team's most recent completed eligible game before the upcoming matchup.
